pat_rm_01.author: Lukas Weber
pat_rm_01.text: Here is the semicolon-delimited German HGB trial balance export for Kelvion Flow Systems GmbH (accounts 4000-4999 revenue, 5000-5999 material cost). Map it to the RIG-III board P&L lines and explain why EBITDA missed budget by EUR 190k.

pat_rm_01.author: Nina Kovacs
pat_rm_01.text: Convert September management accounts for Varn Precision Optics AB (SEK budget 11.20, actual 11.48) and Nordic ColdChain Logistics AS (NOK budget 11.50, actual 11.79) into EUR. Separate constant-currency operational EBITDA variance from FX translation and check Nordic ColdChain's net debt (EUR 39.8m) against LTM EBITDA (EUR 11.05m) and its 3.75x covenant.

pat_rm_02.text: Attached are the commercial advisor IRL (82 rows) and financial QoE advisor IRL (94 rows) for Project Alpine. Deduplicate overlapping customer-churn and backlog questions and output a clean CSV with seller owner columns.

pat_rm_03.author: Jonas Bergmann
pat_rm_03.text: I paraphrased 14 anonymized LP side-letter co-investment clauses from RIG-IV below. Group them by required notice business days (3 days, 5 days, 10 days) and commitment size threshold.

pat_rm_03.author: Sophie Albers
pat_rm_03.text: We are allocating the EUR 12m Solvay Grid Controls follow-on co-investment tranche next week. Which RIG-IV LPs require a <5 business-day ROFO notice or hold grid/defense telemetry ESG opt-out clauses?

wf_augi_01.author: Lukas Lindner
wf_augi_01.role: Lead Chassis & BIW Architect, AUGI Sable
wf_augi_01.text: Using our Bredt-Batho closed-section torsion approximation for the AUGI Sable skateboard, compare SABLE-A (modular 6082-T6 extrusion + bolt-in pack, 3040 mm wheelbase, 1690/1700 mm track, 3.2 mm wall) against SABLE-B (Cell-to-Body 82% pack shear coupling + 22MnB5 boron torque rings, 3.0 mm wall). What happens if we stretch wheelbase to 3120 mm?

wf_augi_01.author: Kenji Takahashi
wf_augi_01.role: Senior Sill Extrusion & Underbody Load-Path Engineer
wf_augi_01.text: Sweep the 6-chamber AA 6082-T6 rocker extrusion wall gauge from 2.2 mm to 4.5 mm in 0.2 mm steps on SABLE-B (195x135 mm section) and SABLE-C (200x135 mm section with AlSi7Mg C611 megacastings). Plot structural mass (kg) vs torsional stiffness (kN·m/deg).

wf_augi_02.author: Kenji Takahashi
wf_augi_02.role: Senior Sill Extrusion & Underbody Load-Path Engineer
wf_augi_02.text: We are joining a 3.0 mm AA 6082-T6 top sill flange to a 1.8 mm 22MnB5 boron steel B-pillar torque ring on SABLE-B. Which self-piercing rivet (SPR) or flow-drill screw (FDS) stackup and structural epoxy bond-line thickness prevent galvanic corrosion and die cracking?

wf_augi_02.author: Dr. Astrid Vestergaard
wf_augi_02.text: Check supplier heat-batch certificate spec AlSi7Mg-C611-F (0.2% proof stress >= 195 MPa, elongation A5 >= 10%) for the SABLE-C rear megacasting flange where it bonds and rivets to the 3.4 mm 6082-T6 rocker extrusion.
